every run in that workspace, whatever the defaults later become.
RUL-config_authoritative.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_authoritative.title: The workspace's configuration governs it, not the defaults

RUL-config_in_dependencies.content:
The configuration SHALL be a dependency of what is derived under it, like every other artifact, so that a change to it
never changes a run without being detected. A digest of its whole content SHALL be recorded for integrity.
RUL-config_in_dependencies.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_in_dependencies.title: The configuration is a dependency of what is made under it

RUL-config_never_media.content:
No phase SHALL treat the configuration as media: none SHALL inventory or organize it, and none SHALL fold it into what
identifies the media.
RUL-config_never_media.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_never_media.title: The configuration is never media

RUL-config_seeded_once.content:
A prep run that finds no configuration SHALL create one from the seed defaults. A prep run that finds one SHALL use it as
it is.
RUL-config_seeded_once.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_seeded_once.title: Prep seeds the configuration once

RUL-config_validated_before_use.content:
Every value of the configuration that comes from the user SHALL be validated before it is used (§14 of the shared
contract), as part of reading the configuration — never as a separate, optional pass.
RUL-config_validated_before_use.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_validated_before_use.title: Every value the user supplies is checked before use

RUL-config_writers.content:
The configuration SHALL be written only when prep seeds it, when the user edits it by hand, and by the library setup
below. Geotag SHALL never write it. Merge's planning, dry run and execution SHALL leave it unchanged.
RUL-config_writers.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_writers.title: Who writes the configuration

RUL-control_directory_fixed.content:
Where a workspace keeps its control records — its configuration among them — SHALL be fixed, the same in every
workspace. No setting SHALL move it.
RUL-control_directory_fixed.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-control_directory_fixed.title: Where the control records live is fixed

RUL-control_records_never_media.content:
No phase SHALL take a control record for media. The place they are kept SHALL be left out of every inventory of media as
a whole — not file by file.
RUL-control_records_never_media.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-control_records_never_media.title: The control records' place is never searched for media

RUL-control_records_together.content:
Every control record SHALL be kept in the workspace's one place for them. None SHALL sit among the media or at the
workspace's top level.
RUL-control_records_together.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-control_records_together.title: The control records are kept together, apart from the media

RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.content:
A result that is costly to rebuild SHALL be made stale only by the areas it depends on. A configuration change outside
the camera-time policy SHALL NOT make stale the true times already resolved.
RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.title: Costly results survive edits they do not depend on

RUL-database_image_each_phase.content:
Each phase SHALL keep its database image, refreshed by each of its successful runs and left untouched by every other
phase; a run that does not succeed SHALL leave the image as it was. An image SHALL never be read back as working data,
and every image present SHALL be archived in the package.
RUL-database_image_each_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_image_each_phase.title: Each phase keeps an image of the database at its end

RUL-database_image_whole.content:
A database image SHALL be a consistent state of the database, never a copy torn mid-transaction; an interrupted
capture SHALL leave the earlier image or the new one, whole.
RUL-database_image_whole.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_image_whole.title: An image is whole

RUL-database_is_record.content:
The workspace database SHALL be kept with the control records and archived in the package, never discarded with the
workspace as a cache would be.
RUL-database_is_record.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_is_record.title: The database is part of the record

RUL-database_regions_disjoint.content:
Each phase SHALL write only its own part of the workspace database; no two phases SHALL write the same rows. Finalize
SHALL only read it.
RUL-database_regions_disjoint.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_regions_disjoint.title: Each phase writes only its own part of the database

RUL-decision_kept.content:
A decision the user made SHALL be kept, by every phase and through every run, while what it decides about is
unchanged.
RUL-decision_kept.title: A decision is kept while its target is unchanged

RUL-decision_revisable.content:
A decision SHALL be revised by changing it in the record and running again: the change SHALL reach everything that
depends on it, and no change the tool makes SHALL be irreversible at the level of the decisions. A wrong choice SHALL
never need the mutated files repaired by hand.
RUL-decision_revisable.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-decision_revisable.title: A wrong decision is fixed in the record

RUL-development_after_merge.content:
Development SHALL happen in the library, after merge. A development subfolder anywhere in photos by destination —
even an empty one — SHALL stop geotag's planning, execution and finalize, and merge.
RUL-development_after_merge.title: Development happens in the library, after merge

RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.content:
A dry run SHALL validate the saved plan that execution would carry out, and report on that plan — never on a separate
simulation.
RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.title: A dry run summarises the real plan

RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.content:
Hidden files that arrive in a dump area — the workspace's top level on the run that initializes it, or the inbox — SHALL
be moved to the recoverable quarantine, not merely left out.
RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.title: Hidden files in a dump are quarantined

RUL-every_command_locks.content:
A workspace SHALL have exactly one lock, shared by every command. Every command that reads or changes the workspace
SHALL hold it while it does.
RUL-every_command_locks.title: One lock, taken by every command

RUL-extension_one_class.content:
The configuration SHALL list which extensions are images, raw files and videos. The classes themselves SHALL NOT be
configurable; an extension not listed SHALL be `other`; and an extension SHALL be in exactly one class.
RUL-extension_one_class.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-extension_one_class.title: Each extension is one class of media

RUL-filesystem_agnostic.content:
Nothing in cartographer but the snapshot SHALL depend on a particular filesystem's features; and cartographer SHALL run
fully on a filesystem that has none.
RUL-filesystem_agnostic.omit_reason: a design constraint over the whole code; the gap audit (backlog item 2) checks it
RUL-filesystem_agnostic.title: Only the snapshot depends on the filesystem

RUL-finalize_explicit.content:
Finalize SHALL be a command of its own, never a side effect of geotag's execution. Merge SHALL refuse a workspace that
has not been finalized.
RUL-finalize_explicit.title: Finalize is its own command, and merge requires it

RUL-finalize_non_destructive.content:
Finalize SHALL change nothing in the workspace's media, its other records or the library: it SHALL read the record that
already stands at the end of geotag and write the package from it.
RUL-finalize_non_destructive.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-finalize_non_destructive.title: Finalize only reads and records

RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.content: A media file's fingerprint SHALL stay the same when the pipeline rewrites its metadata or its position, or renames it.
RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.title: A fingerprint survives what the pipeline does to a file

RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.content:
On a workspace not yet initialized, files and folders at the top level SHALL be the first dump, and SHALL start
initialization. A symbolic link there SHALL still block.
RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.title: A new workspace's first dump is at its top level

RUL-folder_names_not_roles.content:
The configuration SHALL set the managed folders' names. Their roles, and the structure they form, SHALL NOT be
configurable, and every phase SHALL find a managed folder by its role, never by its name.
RUL-folder_names_not_roles.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-folder_names_not_roles.title: The user names the folders; their roles are fixed

RUL-geotag_gates.content:
Geotag SHALL proceed when, and only when, the workspace now satisfies its gates: photos by date holds no photo; photos by
destination holds only photos and no development subfolder; prep has recorded every photo in it; and the inbox is
empty. Whether, or how often, prep, the sort or geotag ran before SHALL NOT bear on it, so the user may run any number
of prep and sort cycles before geotagging.
RUL-geotag_gates.title: Geotag's gates are the present state, not its history

RUL-geotag_name_final.content:
Geotag SHALL recompute a file's name from its corrected local time at the destination — its resolved true time, in the
destination's civil timezone — and rename it to that final name.
RUL-geotag_name_final.title: Geotag's name is final

RUL-geotag_rerun_keeps_settled.content:
A geotag re-run SHALL recognise in each file what an earlier run wrote there: a time geotag corrected SHALL NOT be
corrected again, and a position geotag wrote SHALL be derived again and replaced, never kept as the file's own. The
user's decisions, and files already right, it keeps as every run does.
RUL-geotag_rerun_keeps_settled.title: A re-run changes nothing already settled

RUL-geotag_rerunnable.content:
Geotag SHALL be re-runnable any number of times — after a successful execution too — for as long as the workspace has
not been merged.
RUL-geotag_rerunnable.title: Geotag may be re-run until merge

RUL-geotag_reuses_camera_group.content: Geotag SHALL use the camera group prep derived, and SHALL NOT derive a file's identity again.
RUL-geotag_reuses_camera_group.title: Geotag reuses prep's camera group

RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.content:
Geotag SHALL verify prep's handoff before using it, though it lives among the control records: by recomputing the
fingerprint of its content and comparing it with the one its dependencies recorded — by its content, not its exact
bytes.
RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.title: Geotag verifies the handoff by its content

RUL-hash_detects_any_change.content:
A record's hash SHALL change on any change to its bytes, and SHALL be what checks a record or the configuration as a
dependency. Prep's handoff is the one exception: it is checked by its content.
RUL-hash_detects_any_change.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-hash_detects_any_change.title: A hash changes with any byte

RUL-history_retained.content:
The records the log is made from SHALL be kept across runs in enough detail to rebuild every photo's history through
each phase — each step, the decision and inputs behind it, and the run that made it — never only the last run's.
Anything beyond that MAY be pruned.
RUL-history_retained.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-history_retained.title: History is kept across runs, as much as the log needs

RUL-known_when_classified.content:
A camera group SHALL be known when the configuration classes it as a phone or as a camera with a fixed clock, and
unknown otherwise.
RUL-known_when_classified.title: A camera group is known once it is classified

RUL-library_file_read_once.content:
A library file's fingerprint SHALL be computed only when a collision needs it, and kept, so that a library file
unchanged since is never fingerprinted again in the workspace, in that run or a later one.
RUL-library_file_read_once.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_file_read_once.title: A library file is read at most once while unchanged

RUL-library_never_altered.content:
Merge SHALL never rename, overwrite, move, delete or change a file already in the library; where an incoming photo's
place is taken, the incoming photo SHALL give way.
RUL-library_never_altered.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_never_altered.title: Merge never alters the library

RUL-library_not_scanned.content:
Merge SHALL touch the library only at the places its photos go, and read a library file only when one is already
there. It SHALL NOT scan, index or de-duplicate the library.
RUL-library_not_scanned.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_not_scanned.title: Merge reads the library only where it places a photo

RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.content:
Merge's one-time library setup, run inside a workspace and given a library, MAY record in the configuration which
library this workspace merges into — that setting, and no other.
RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.title: The library setup records one setting

RUL-lock_before_reading.content:
A run SHALL hold the lock before it reads any of the workspace's content — before it plans, scans, fingerprints,
reads metadata, dry-runs or executes. Planning changes nothing, and is inside the lock all the same.
RUL-lock_before_reading.title: The lock comes before anything is read

RUL-lock_fail_fast.content:
A run that finds the workspace locked SHALL NOT wait for it. It SHALL stop at once, saying the workspace is locked by a
run in progress, having scanned, planned and changed nothing — and having produced no plan, no dry-run report and no
artifact.
RUL-lock_fail_fast.title: A locked workspace is refused at once

RUL-lock_released_on_any_end.content: A run SHALL release the lock when it ends, whether it succeeds or fails.
RUL-lock_released_on_any_end.title: The lock is released however the run ends

RUL-lock_through_the_run.content:
A run SHALL hold the lock until it ends — through planning, dry run, execution, and every record and artifact it
writes — and SHALL release it then. The lock SHALL NOT outlive its run: between runs, the workspace is unlocked.
RUL-lock_through_the_run.title: The lock lasts the whole run, and no longer

RUL-log_cites_decisions.content: A step that followed from a decision SHALL name that decision, so the why stands beside the what.
RUL-log_cites_decisions.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_cites_decisions.title: A step names the decision behind it

RUL-log_entry_grows.content:
A photo's entry in the log SHALL gather the steps of every phase it passes through and be whole through the latest of
them; each phase SHALL only append its own steps, never rewrite an earlier one. The latest phase's log SHALL be the full
record; each earlier log stays its own phase's.
RUL-log_entry_grows.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_entry_grows.title: A photo's entry grows one phase at a time

RUL-log_human_readable.content:
The log SHALL be readable as it stands, with no separate report: stably ordered, with descriptive names, and values as a
person reads them — times, timezones and offsets.
RUL-log_human_readable.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_human_readable.title: The log reads as it stands

RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.content:
The log SHALL key each photo's entry by its fingerprint and carry the chain of names and places it passed through. A
file of no media class SHALL have no entry.
RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.title: The log is keyed by fingerprint

RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.content:
A manual position applied, changed or withdrawn SHALL appear in the log with the position it replaced or restored, or
that there was none.
RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.title: A manual position's reversal is logged like its application

RUL-merge_is_terminal.content:
Merge SHALL be the last phase run in a workspace: once it succeeds, more media SHALL go to a fresh workspace, and the
library SHALL accept merges from many workspaces.
RUL-merge_is_terminal.title: Merge ends the workspace

RUL-merge_moves.content:
Merge SHALL move each photo it places: the workspace's copy SHALL be removed only once the library's is verified in
place, and a photo already in the library SHALL be removed likewise. A photo merge cannot place SHALL stay where it is,
the run then partial.
RUL-merge_moves.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_moves.title: Merge moves, and a photo leaves the workspace only once safe in the library

RUL-merge_records_landing.content:
Merge SHALL record, in its own records, where each photo landed in the library, whether it was renamed there, which
were already present, and what blocked the rest. Nothing SHALL be built from merge's records.
RUL-merge_records_landing.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_records_landing.title: Merge records where every photo landed

RUL-merge_reseals.content:
A merge that succeeds SHALL remake the archival package to hold its own records too, as part of the same run and with
no command of its own, from the records as they stand: it SHALL re-derive nothing of an earlier phase.
RUL-merge_reseals.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_reseals.title: Merge remakes the package as part of its run

RUL-merge_resumable.content:
A merge interrupted SHALL be finished by running it again, which SHALL apply only what is outstanding; merging a batch
already merged SHALL change nothing.
RUL-merge_resumable.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_resumable.title: Merge resumes, and a merged batch is a no-op

RUL-merge_snapshots_library.content: Prep's and geotag's snapshot SHALL cover the workspace; merge's SHALL cover the library, where its changes land.
RUL-merge_snapshots_library.omit_reason: carried by merge's own snapshot items, when merge is converted
RUL-merge_snapshots_library.title: Merge snapshots the library

RUL-merge_takes_finalized_current.content:
Merge SHALL require that geotag's execution succeeded and the workspace was finalized, and SHALL refuse when photos by
destination has changed since finalize — so what reaches the library is always the corrected, named, fully recorded
set. A refresh that changes only what describes a prep run SHALL NOT count as a change.
RUL-merge_takes_finalized_current.title: Merge takes only the finalized, current set

RUL-missing_folder_blocks.content:
On an initialized workspace, a missing managed folder SHALL block every phase. It SHALL NOT be recreated outside
initialization, and no phase SHALL organize media into a structure it had to rebuild. The block SHALL name the missing
folders, say that something is wrong, and tell the user to restore them and run again; an empty folder restores one.
An empty inbox SHALL be normal — the steady state, not a missing folder.
RUL-missing_folder_blocks.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_blocks.title: A missing managed folder blocks, and is never rebuilt

RUL-more_dumps_until_merge.content:
A new dump SHALL be accepted into the inbox at any point before merge, after a successful geotag too; the loop then
resumes from prep.
RUL-more_dumps_until_merge.title: More dumps may follow until merge

RUL-mutate_on_difference.content:
In every phase and every run, a file SHALL be moved, renamed or written only where its current state differs from what
the run requires of it. A file already in its place, with its name and its metadata, SHALL produce no operation.
RUL-mutate_on_difference.title: A file is changed only where it differs

RUL-no_links.content:
No phase SHALL follow or organize a symbolic link. A link anywhere among the managed files SHALL block — a link to a
file anywhere; a link to a folder inside a dump or a managed folder, whose mere presence blocks though it is never
entered; a managed folder that is itself a link, before it is walked; a link at the top level — never be skipped
silently. The phase SHALL name the link and produce no executable plan and no artifact after it.
RUL-no_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_links.title: No symbolic link is followed, and any link blocks

RUL-no_op_run.content:
A phase run over a workspace whose relevant state has not changed SHALL change nothing, and SHALL produce the same result
— the same operations, fingerprints and names. It SHALL report the work it reused and the files already right, and SHALL
NOT treat earlier work as an error.
RUL-no_op_run.title: A run over unchanged inputs changes nothing

RUL-no_plan_location_option.content: No command SHALL take an option saying where to put a plan or where to find one; the fixed place is the contract.
RUL-no_plan_location_option.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_location_option.title: No command is told where a plan is

RUL-no_plan_no_run.content: A dry run or an execution that finds no plan in its place SHALL stop, and tell the user to plan first.
RUL-no_plan_no_run.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_no_run.title: No plan, no dry run and no execution

RUL-nonconforming_name_is_a_dump.content:
A file in the workspace whose name does not follow the format SHALL be treated as any other dump — taken in and named
by the pipeline — never specially migrated or matched against patterns. No phase SHALL read meaning from a file's name:
its timestamp SHALL come from its metadata.
RUL-nonconforming_name_is_a_dump.title: A name off the format is an ordinary dump

RUL-not_inventoried.content:
Prep SHALL leave out of its inventory of media, each as a whole: the control records' place, the quarantine, a
version-control directory, and the strays folder with everything in it; and every hidden file. Prep SHALL write into the
strays folder but never scan it, and nothing SHALL process its contents again.
RUL-not_inventoried.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-not_inventoried.title: What prep never inventories

RUL-one_configuration.content:
All three phases SHALL read their settings from the workspace's one configuration, each the settings it needs. No phase
SHALL keep settings of its own, and no setting that governs a run SHALL come from outside the workspace.
RUL-one_configuration.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-one_configuration.title: One configuration, read by every phase

RUL-one_database.content:
A workspace SHALL hold exactly one database of record, and the library none. Any other database a phase keeps SHALL be
scratch: holding no decision and no history, safe to delete at any time, and neither journalled nor archived.
RUL-one_database.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-one_database.title: One database, in the workspace

RUL-one_filename_format.content:
Prep and geotag SHALL name files from a timestamp in one format for the whole pipeline, not one for each phase, set by
the configuration; neither SHALL hard-code it.
RUL-one_filename_format.title: One format, set by the configuration

RUL-organization_settings_restale.content:
A change to the managed folders' names, or to which extensions are which class of media, SHALL make stale geotag's
executable plan and merge's plan.
RUL-organization_settings_restale.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-organization_settings_restale.title: A change to the folder names or the media classes restales the plans

RUL-package_contents.content:
The archival package SHALL hold every control record but the transient ones, archived together with its own list of
them: the configuration that governed the workspace; every current decision and plan record, exactly as the pipeline
validated it; the database, with its snapshot from the end of each phase; every phase's transformation log; and every
run's journal.
RUL-package_contents.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_contents.title: What the package holds

RUL-package_self_describing.content:
The package SHALL say which workspace it came from and which plan and execution it records, and list its contents with
each item's hash, so its integrity can be checked later.
RUL-package_self_describing.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_self_describing.title: The package describes itself

RUL-partial_history_shown.content:
A phase whose kept history cannot rebuild a photo's journey through it SHALL fail, or mark its record plainly partial;
it SHALL NOT write a log that looks whole but reflects only the last run.
RUL-partial_history_shown.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-partial_history_shown.title: A history too thin to rebuild is never shown as whole

RUL-phase_writes_own_records.content:
Each numbered record SHALL be written by the phase whose number it carries, and by no other. A phase MAY create,
rewrite or extend its own records across its runs; it SHALL read every other phase's records read-only.
RUL-phase_writes_own_records.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-phase_writes_own_records.title: Each phase writes only its own records

RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.content:
Each phase's plan, and each of its decision records, SHALL have one fixed place among the control records. The phase's
planning SHALL write it there, and its dry run and its execution SHALL read it from there.
RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.title: Each plan has one fixed place

RUL-prep_derives_camera_group.content:
Prep SHALL derive each file's camera group from its device-identity metadata, and record it both in what it hands
geotag and in its own records.
RUL-prep_derives_camera_group.title: Prep derives the camera group

RUL-prep_empties_inbox.content:
A prep execution SHALL leave the inbox empty: photos to photos by date, videos to videos by date, media with no capture
time to missing metadata, and every file of no media class to the strays folder.
RUL-prep_empties_inbox.title: Prep leaves the inbox empty

RUL-prep_name_provisional.content:
Prep SHALL derive a file's name from its raw timestamp, as the camera recorded it, for organizing and ordering only.
The name SHALL be provisional: prep SHALL NOT correct it, resolve its timezone or convert it to UTC.
RUL-prep_name_provisional.title: Prep's name is provisional

RUL-prep_records_sort.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT plan while photos by destination holds a photo prep has not recorded where it now is. A prep run after
the latest sort SHALL record the moves from the files' sizes and modification times alone, carrying each moved file's
identity forward without reading it again.
RUL-prep_records_sort.title: Prep records every sort before geotag plans

RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.content: Prep SHALL ask the user for no decision: it SHALL organize from the state of the workspace and its configuration alone.
RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.title: Prep takes no decision

RUL-record_whole_each_phase.content:
At the end of every phase the workspace SHALL hold a complete, self-sufficient, human-readable record of everything done
to its files so far: whole whether or not any later phase ever runs, and extended by each phase through its own work. A
phase not yet run SHALL read as the workspace not having advanced, never as a record incomplete.
RUL-record_whole_each_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-record_whole_each_phase.title: The record is whole at the end of every phase

RUL-remake_only_what_depends.content:
When an input changes, only the records that depend on it SHALL be made again; every other record SHALL be left as it
is.
RUL-remake_only_what_depends.title: Only what depends on a change is made again

RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.content:
Re-planning SHALL never overwrite a plan or a decision record. When what it makes differs from what is saved, the saved
one SHALL first be set aside, recoverably, and the user told where.
RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.title: Re-planning sets the prior plan aside

RUL-required_snapshot_or_nothing.content: When the configuration requires snapshots, a run that cannot take one SHALL stop before it changes anything.
RUL-required_snapshot_or_nothing.title: A required snapshot that fails stops the run

RUL-rerun_does_what_changed.content:
A re-run SHALL redo exactly the work its changed inputs require — new media, an edited setting, changed tracks, a
withdrawn or altered decision, a refreshed handoff — and no more. It MAY ask for new decisions, but only for the items
the change affects.
RUL-rerun_does_what_changed.title: A re-run does as much as what changed requires

RUL-reuse_valid_work.content:
Work already done and still valid SHALL be reused, not repeated: a file's content and metadata SHALL be read, and the
tracks parsed, only for inputs that are new or have changed.
RUL-reuse_valid_work.title: Valid work is reused

RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.content:
A rewrite of the handoff that changes only what describes the run, not its content, SHALL NOT make anything downstream
stale.
RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.title: Refreshing what describes the run restales nothing

RUL-seal_is_authority.content: Whether a workspace is finished SHALL be read from its seal alone, never from the state of its folders.
RUL-seal_is_authority.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-seal_is_authority.title: The seal alone says a workspace is finished

RUL-seal_on_success_only.content:
Merge SHALL seal the workspace only when it succeeds whole: every photo by destination placed in the library or found
already there, none left. A partial, failed or interrupted merge SHALL leave the workspace unsealed.
RUL-seal_on_success_only.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-seal_on_success_only.title: Only a whole merge seals

RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.content:
A command refusing a sealed workspace that finds files where a dump would land — the workspace's top level or the
inbox — SHALL say that a new dump is likely there and must go to a fresh workspace, and SHALL leave it exactly where it
is.
RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.title: A new dump in a sealed workspace is pointed out and left

RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.content: Pruning the quarantine SHALL remain allowed in a sealed workspace, and SHALL be the only change allowed there.
RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.title: Pruning the quarantine is still allowed

RUL-sealed_refuses.content:
In a sealed workspace prep, geotag and merge SHALL stop as they start, changing and touching nothing, and the decision
editor SHALL neither open it nor save into it; nor SHALL merge's library setup record a library in its configuration.
Its records MAY still be read.
RUL-sealed_refuses.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_refuses.title: A sealed workspace is never processed again

RUL-shape_checked_first.content:
Each phase SHALL check the workspace's shape at its start — right after the lock and the seal check, before it scans,
plans or changes anything.
RUL-shape_checked_first.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-shape_checked_first.title: The shape is checked first

RUL-snapshot_off_by_default.content: Snapshots SHALL be off unless the workspace's configuration turns them on.
RUL-snapshot_off_by_default.title: No snapshot unless configured

RUL-snapshot_optional.content:
A phase that changes files MAY first take a snapshot of what it is about to change, from which the whole change can be
rolled back. Cartographer SHALL be complete and safe without one: no guarantee SHALL depend on a snapshot having been
taken.
RUL-snapshot_optional.title: A snapshot is optional, and nothing rests on it

RUL-snapshot_per_plan.content: Each snapshot SHALL be identifiable by the plan whose changes it precedes.
RUL-snapshot_per_plan.title: A snapshot names its plan

RUL-snapshot_timing.content:
A snapshot SHALL be taken after the plan has been validated against its dependencies and the lock is held, and before
the plan's first change.
RUL-snapshot_timing.title: When a snapshot is taken

RUL-sort_photos_only.content:
Photos by destination SHALL hold only photos: videos stay in videos by date, and no file of no media class belongs there.
Geotag SHALL refuse to run while it holds anything else.
RUL-sort_photos_only.title: Only photos are sorted into photos by destination

RUL-stale_lock_recovered.content:
A lock left behind by a run that died SHALL be recognisable as stale, and recoverable, so that a crash never leaves a
workspace locked for good.
RUL-stale_lock_recovered.title: A stale lock is recognised and recovered

RUL-stale_takeover_conservative.content:
A stale lock SHALL be taken over only when its owner is provably gone. A lock whose owner may still be running SHALL be
left alone.
RUL-stale_takeover_conservative.title: Only a dead owner's lock is taken over

RUL-staleness_by_area.content:
A change to one area of the configuration SHALL make stale only what depends on that area. A change to the track
thresholds restales placement and the plans, not the renames; a change to the filename format restales the renames,
not placement.
RUL-staleness_by_area.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-staleness_by_area.title: A change to one area restales only what depends on it

RUL-structure_built_once.content:
Prep SHALL create the full structure of managed folders exactly once, when it initializes the workspace, and SHALL never
remove one. No other phase SHALL create or repair the workspace's structure; the folders merge creates in the library
are placement, not structure.
RUL-structure_built_once.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-structure_built_once.title: Only prep builds the structure, once

RUL-suffix_choice_by_phase.content:
Prep and geotag SHALL take the first free name — the name with no suffix when it is free, otherwise the lowest free
suffix — by one identical rule. Merge SHALL take the suffix above the highest already used for that name, never a lower
one that has come free.
RUL-suffix_choice_by_phase.title: Which free name each phase takes

RUL-suffix_no_clobber.content:
A file whose timestamp name is already taken SHALL get a zero-padded differentiating suffix, allocated deterministically
and without clobbering: against every name on disk and every name planned in the run, compared without regard to case,
so that two files never collide.
RUL-suffix_no_clobber.title: A taken name gets a suffix, never clobbering

RUL-top_level_only_managed.content:
The top level of an initialized workspace SHALL hold only the managed folders, the control records' place, the
quarantine and hidden entries. Any other entry — a file, a folder, a link — SHALL be a misplaced dump, and block every
phase alike. The inbox SHALL be the only place a dump belongs.
RUL-top_level_only_managed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-top_level_only_managed.title: The top level holds only what belongs there

RUL-track_files_block_prep.content:
A track file — a recorded position log in any of the usual formats, whether or not geotag reads that format — found
anywhere prep inventories, in the dump or in a managed folder, SHALL block prep's plan. Prep SHALL leave it where it is:
never moving it, to the strays folder or anywhere else, and never treating it as a file of no media class.
RUL-track_files_block_prep.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-track_files_block_prep.title: A track file stops prep, and stays where it is

RUL-tracks_geotag_only.content:
Geotag SHALL be the only phase that reads the tracks: it scans their location, parses them, fingerprints them and uses
them as evidence. Prep SHALL NOT read, parse, fingerprint or move them, nor otherwise act on them.
RUL-tracks_geotag_only.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_geotag_only.title: Only geotag reads the tracks

RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.content:
Geotag SHALL record the tracks' fingerprint as a dependency of every record it derives with them — the time decisions,
the drift validation, the GPS decisions and the executable plan — so that a change to the tracks makes those records
stale.
RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.title: The tracks are a dependency of what geotag derives from them

RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.content:
The tracks' location SHALL lie outside the managed folders — neither inside one nor containing one. Where outside them
is the configuration's choice, not part of this contract. A configuration that places it otherwise SHALL be refused
before any phase uses it.
RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.title: The tracks lie outside the managed folders

RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.content: A re-plan whose result is identical to what is saved SHALL write nothing and set nothing aside.
RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.title: An unchanged re-plan writes nothing

RUL-uncorrected_keeps_its_name.content:
A file's name SHALL change between prep and geotag only when its timestamp is corrected. Geotag SHALL plan no rename for
a file whose time is not corrected.
RUL-uncorrected_keeps_its_name.title: An uncorrected file keeps its name

RUL-unrequired_snapshot_proceeds.content:
When snapshots are not required, or not configured, a run SHALL proceed without one. Its safety then rests, as it
always does, on the journal, the recoverable quarantine, never overwriting, and the filesystem as the truth.
RUL-unrequired_snapshot_proceeds.title: Without a required snapshot, the run goes on

RUL-user_writes_decisions.content:
A decision field SHALL be written by the user alone, and no phase SHALL overwrite what the user wrote. A phase SHALL
create every field a decision needs, so the user fills in values, never structure.
RUL-user_writes_decisions.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-user_writes_decisions.title: The user writes the decisions; the tool lays out their fields

RUL-who_checks_for_links.content:
Prep SHALL check for links across the whole tree it walks, the destination tree included though prep never changes it.
Geotag and merge SHALL check the top level themselves, and SHALL consume only a handoff prep built with no link present.
RUL-who_checks_for_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-who_checks_for_links.title: Prep checks the whole tree; the others check the top level

RUL-withdrawal_undoes.content:
Withdrawing a decision SHALL undo its effect, not merely stop asserting it. A manual position withdrawn SHALL give the
file back the position it held before, or none if it held none; a position derived by the tool SHALL be derived again; a
time and a name SHALL be recomputed where the file stands, never moving it out of its destination.
RUL-withdrawal_undoes.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-withdrawal_undoes.title: Withdrawing a decision undoes it

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
